subject: agy
captured_by: P07B session 1 — headless probes run from a scratch git dir; each real turn cost ~20K input tokens of the gemini pool

models_listed.note: The limits table keys by display family without the effort suffix (`agy/Gemini 3.8 Flash`), and its prose says that row covers the High/Medium/Low variants. Mapping an id to its limits row therefore needs id -> family display name, not the raw id.

effort.help_text: --effort  Reasoning effort for the current CLI session (low|medium|high)

observed.result: SUCCESS; init event reports model gemini-3.8-flash

effort.finding: Effort is part of the model selection, and which values work depends on the model. A suffixed id already fixes the effort, and any other --effort conflicts with it. A base id (gemini-3.8-flash) accepts --effort low|medium|high. claude-* rejects --effort outright. Invalid selections fail client-side in about 1s, before any turn and at no quota cost. Maestro's EffortControls is per backend, so it cannot express this per-model vocabulary.

json.argv: agy --output-format json --model gemini-3.8-flash-low -p 'Reply with exactly: OK'
json.note: -p must come LAST: `agy -p --output-format json ...` fails rc=2 because -p takes the next token as its prompt

events: result{conversation_id, status, response, error?, num_turns, usage}
stream_json.per_turn_usage: agent_response step_update carries usage {input_tokens, output_tokens, thinking_tokens, cache_read_tokens, total_tokens}; result.usage is the SUM across turns (41288 after two ~20.6K turns)
exposed: model id (init.model — the id as passed, not a resolved variant)

headless_output.error_shape: ERROR results keep rc=1 and set result.error, e.g. transient 'Eligibility check failed: UNAVAILABLE (code 503)'; a quota-exhaustion error string was NOT observed in this session

resume.evidence: --conversation dfd9c8ca-... continued the same conversation (num_turns 2, step_index continued at 2); cli log: 'project: resuming conversation belonging to project ID: default-cli-project'

session_records.transcript: ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/<conversation_id>/.system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl — steps {step_index, source, type, status, created_at, content}; NO token counts, NO model id
session_records.conversation_db: ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/conversations/<conversation_id>.db (sqlite: steps, gen_metadata, trajectory_meta, ... protobuf blobs; token usage not decoded)
session_records.implication: A cheap per-session context reading for usage(handle) must come from the launcher's own stream-json log (impl.log): last agent_response step_update usage = input_tokens + cache_read_tokens. The transcript cannot supply it.

quota.headless: not emitted by --print json or stream-json
quota.push_surface: ~/.gemini/statusline_dump.json, written by the operator's interactive status-line script; a 1.2.2 capture (2026-09-15 13:02) confirms the four pools gemini-5h, gemini-weekly, 3p-5h, 3p-weekly, each {remaining_fraction, reset_time, reset_in_seconds}, plus model.id/display_name/effort, version and context_window
quota.finding: No headless pull path. The only quota surface is a push from an interactive render maestro does not control, the same pattern as Claude's usage.json.
